title: Reverb ↔ Space-Time
idiom: Haeckel-style scientific engraving crossed with architectural cross-section ink drawing
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop. A cathedral cross-section rendered in fine Haeckel engraving style — ink lines only, no colour. Sound waves radiate from a single point source near the floor; each successive reflection arrives at a listener figure (gender-neutral, abstract) with a numbered time label in milliseconds. The reflections form concentric arcs that also read as spacetime light-cones. The geometry of the room IS the geometry of the delay lines. One dominant figure dwells inside the sound field, not observing it. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem. A single sound-wave arc doubling as a spacetime light-cone — thick clean lines, no fine detail, no text, no numerals. Black on off-white or white on deep charcoal. Must survive at 24px. No letters, no labels, purely pictorial.
